name: macOS native radios
limits: CoreBluetooth BLE + CoreWLAN WiFi. UUID-only BLE fallback; optional private address lookup in the default build does not guarantee stable MACs or App Store suitability.

name: Linux native radios
limits: BlueZ BLE and WiFi scanning. Monitor-interface capture needs a compatible configured interface; controller and driver capabilities vary.

name: M5StickC Plus2
limits: ESP32 firmware with display, buttons and separate observation/match counts. no_std and ESP-IDF are distinct builds; check runtime-specific validation.

name: XIAO ESP32-S3
limits: Board-specific firmware. M5 test results do not establish XIAO acceptance or enabled PSRAM.

name: CatSniffer 3.2 / Sniffle
limits: Passive BLE live stream and DLT256 replay. Fixed primary advertising channel; extended-chain reassembly and Coded PHY reception are not validated. External firmware/tools required.

name: ALFA AWUS036ACHM
limits: MT7610U passive WiFi receiver, not an OS network driver. Endurance interrupted by calibration timeout; RF parity, RSSI calibration and fault recovery remain open.

name: gpsd location input
limits: Adds the receiver’s position to observations. Moving-route accuracy and capture-time/fix association still need validation; not a device-location estimate.

name: CSR8510 A10
limits: Offline HCI tooling and investigation. No live macOS USB driver or production ingestion path.

name: Nordic nRF Sniffer
limits: USB presence/live upstream reports do not establish AirHound support. A separate DLT272 observation source is not implemented.

name: AWOK Dual ESP32 v3
limits: Exact board/firmware integration remains under investigation. No supported AirHound firmware or desktop ingestion.

name: Flipper Zero / sub-GHz
limits: Companion and additional-radio work is on the roadmap. No released Flipper or sub-GHz observation integration.
